(i) the packet loss rate for cache-untenable user decreases with the increase of cache size, but that for cache-enabled user is not necessarily decreasing with the increase of the cache size; (ii) the packet loss rates are affected by both cache size and traffic load; and (iii) the packet loss probability for cache-enabled user decreases with the decrease of the cache size.
